_source: Retail heroes.exe (md5 a7daabf9a316d271962ca19f89b80335), AI spell chooser 0xc9c10, scorer 0xc9ddb, effect value 0xca23a, damage value 0xca8fc, cure/dispel 0xca616, resurrect 0xca806. Transcribed 2026-09-26; rule written up in data/knowledge_base/auto-combat-ai.md section 7.
_creature_value: Per-creature value V, creature table field at data 0x1fcaa + native_id * 0x1c. A stack is worth count * V.
_effect_weight: E(stack, spell) = weight * count * V (data 0x1beb4..0x1bed4). Slow is per step of speed above 1; Haste is 0.33 at speed 1 and half that at speed 2.
_resistance: The exe scales a Dwarf stack's negative effect values and the damage it would take by 0.75 (data 0x32d4, 0x32dc). Read here as 1 - magic_resist from data/creatures/stats.json, which is 0.25 for Dwarves only.
_spell_power_shift: Buff and debuff scores are shifted right by this many bits at the caster's spell power; 0 from 3 up.
_wound_factor: A leftover wound counts this share of a hit point in damage scores (data 0x32e4).
_finishing_blow: Score of a damage spell that wipes out a side while the caster loses nothing: base minus the per-spell word at data 0x1f17c + 2 * native spell id.
